notes.title: Price Reduction for The Backrooms Regret
notes.content:
Starting today, the price of The Backrooms Regret will be reduced from $3.99 to $1.99 permanently.

We want more players to have the chance to try the game, and we believe this price adjustment will make it more accessible.

We appreciate the support from the community and hope you enjoy the experience.

[b]Noirware[/b]

notes.title: Issue with Downloading the Game – Now Fixed
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We were aware that some players experienced an issue where the game appeared as 0B in size and could not be installed. We contacted Steam Support, and after applying their solution, the issue should now be fully resolved.

If you were affected, please try restarting Steam and attempting the download again. If you still encounter any problems, let us know in the discussions or through support, and we will do our best to assist you.

Thank you for your patience and support!

[b]Noirware[/b]

notes.title: The Backrooms Regret - Revamp Update
notes.content:
After several months of waiting, we finally bring you a [b]huge[/b] update.

Below is the full list of changes, additions, and improvements in this update (V0.1.0.0).

[u][b]New: [/b][/u]

-New options:
HUD: Buttons to show/hide basic elements.
Aspect Ratio: Toggle between 16:9, 16:10, 4:3, Ultrawide, and Super Ultrawide.
Graphic Quality: Predefined selection: Low, Medium, High, and Epic.
Visual Options: Toggle motion blur and blur on/off.
Master Volume: Slider bar.
Mouse or Joystick Sensitivity: Slider bar.
Invert Axes: Checkbox for X or Y Axis.
Cinetosis: Checkbox to reduce camera movement. Checkbox to disable shakes.

-New difficulties when starting the game:
Explorer Mode (Easy): Enemies are slower and less perceptive.
Intruder Mode (Original): The standard experience.
Paranoia Mode (Hard): Increased enemy speed and perception.

-New crouch mechanic.

-New auto-save system.

-Dynamized initial chase based on player feedback.

-Completely recreated and improved main menu.

-New object interaction system.

-New In-Game interface.

-Recreation of the pause menu, with an Inventory and Objectives.

-New English voice acting.

-New translations in Catalan, Spanish, and Italian.

-New achievements.

[u][b]Improvements: [/b][/u]

-Collision fixes and improvements.

-Enemy AI improvements.

-Gameplay-to-Cutscene and Cutscene-to-Gameplay transition improvements.

-Asset Dressing and environment decoration improvements.

-The second area of the game completely recreated with new areas to explore, new mechanics, as well as new interactable objects and extra content.

[u][b]Fixes: [/b][/u]

-Entity bug fixes.

-Lighting bug fixes.

-General bug fixes.

All of this and more can now be found in the new update for The Backrooms Regret!
Those who already had the game in their library can enjoy this update and all the upcoming content (i.e., the remaining Parts) for free.

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: The Backrooms Regret - Part 0: Prologue- Important Update
notes.content:
Hello again, players!

This is Íker Queral speaking, one of the founders of Noirware and the lead developer of The Backrooms Regret. Today, I’m thrilled to share some exciting news: the next update for the Prologue is almost finished. Over the past few months, I’ve been gathering feedback and reviews from our amazing users, and I’ve worked hard to improve and refine every aspect that needed attention or was less well-received. Additionally, I’ve added a decent amount of new content to enhance and perfect the overall experience.

I deeply apologize for the lack of updates, patches, or announcements during this time. As I’m the one handling almost everything, I decided to focus on development and prepare a massive update. I also want to remind you that this is still not my full-time job, so I can’t dedicate as much time to it as I’d like regularly. Without further ado, here’s a list of everything I’ve already developed and what’s still in progress.

[i][b]- Developed -[/b][/i]

· New Options:
[HUD]:
Buttons to show/hide basic elements.
[Aspect Ratio]:
Switch between 16:9, 16:10, 4:3, Ultrawide, and Super Ultrawide.
[Graphic Quality]:
Preset selections: Low, Medium, High, and Epic.
[Visual Options]:
Enable/disable motion blur and blur effects.
[Master Volume]:
Slider bar.
[Mouse/Joystick Sensitivity]:
Slider bar.
[Invert Axes]:
Checkbox for X or Y axis.
[Motion Sickness]:
Checkbox to reduce camera movement.
Checkbox to disable camera shakes.

· New difficulties when starting the game:
[Explorer Mode (Easy)]: Slower and less perceptive enemies.
[Intruder Mode (Original)]: The standard experience.
[Paranoia Mode (Hard)]: Increased enemy speed and perception.

· New crouching mechanic
· Collision fixes and improvements
· Enhanced enemy AI
· Fixed save system bugs
· Dynamized initial chase sequence based on player feedback
· Fully recreated and improved main menu
· New object interaction system
· Improved Gameplay-Cinematic transitions and vice versa
· Enhanced Asset Dressing and environmental decorations
· Second game area fully recreated with new zones to explore, new mechanics, interactive objects, and extra content
· New in-game interface

[i][b]- In Development -[/b][/i]

· Recreation of the Pause Menu, including Inventory and Objectives
· Revamped and improved Extras
· New English voiceover
· New translations into Catalan, Spanish, and Italian
· New achievements
· New compatibility with PS5 controllers and Steam Deck

As you can see, this update will bring a wide range of changes and new features. Because of this, we’ve decided that the Prologue will no longer be free and will be priced at:
[u][i]€3.99[/i][/u]
Of course, all users who claimed the game during the 6+ months it was available for free will enjoy this update without spending a single cent.

On the same day we launch the update, we’ll release another announcement discussing Part I of The Backrooms Regret.

Thank you so much for your patience and support!

notes.title: The Backrooms Regret - Part 0: Prologue
notes.content:
After the release of the DEMO almost four months ago, we have been working on improving, fixing, and adding new content to our project.

Finally, our efforts have paid off; today we present you with the list of all the new features that will be included in Part 0. For those who haven't heard: this month we will be releasing Part 0 (a significant update compared to the DEMO) completely free of charge.

Here is the list of everything new that this version will bring (compared to the last update released for the DEMO):

[b]· Full compatibility with XBOX controller ·
· Complete rework of all menus and their interface ·
· Complete rework of the first pursuit ·
· New collectibles (cards) ·
· New interface during gameplay ·
· Two new achievements ·
· Extras section ·
· New final cinematic ·
· New sound effects ·
· Fixing of some bugs ·
· Improvement in the second zone ·
· Improvement in the final pursuit ·
· Improvement in some cinematics ·[/b]

For now, Part 0 will only include this content. For the next patch (which we will release between May and June), we plan to add:

· Catalan and Italian translations ·
· New dialogues (around 20) ·

The streamers we collaborate with can already try out this new version; for the rest of the public, we will release it shortly, as we want to make sure it doesn't have any bugs!

notes.title: The Backrooms Regret - Demo Publishment
notes.content:
Welcome to the first official announcement from Noirware on our Steam page.

Today, we would like to announce that the DEMO of The Backrooms Regret will be released before the end of 2023. We believe we can have it between January 14. Some content creators may have the opportunity to try it earlier, but we have decided to provide almost a week of margin to address any issues that may arise.

This DEMO will be translated into Spanish (Spain and Latin American) and English.

Soon, we will continue to make announcements like this one. Add The Backrooms Regret to your wishlist and try the DEMO as soon as it is released!

Stay tuned for more updates!
